name: Vistra VFunds

web.notes: Vistra states single sign-on and multi-factor authentication; factor types not stated.

notes: Vistra's branded platform for fund managers and investors: interactive dashboards, document exchange, web onboarding (high confidence, Vistra page). VFunds 2.0 (Dec 2021) was reported as 'powered by Eleven'; that vendor was not identified further, so the underlying software is unconfirmed. Entry describes the Vistra-branded portal until the vendor is identified.
